title: 2020 roadmap on pore materials for energy and environmental applications
claim: Nanocrystal-derived aerogels offer a broader route to tailored composition and surface properties than gelation confined to molecular-precursor condensation or polymerization.
explanation: Controllable destabilization and assembly of colloidal nanocrystals forms a three-dimensional hydrogel network while retaining properties of its building blocks.
conditions: Colloidal nanocrystals must be assembled into an interconnected gel.
caveats: Successful gelation can be hindered by stabilizing surface ligands or surfactants.
